bio: Holbeck Ghyll Country House Hotel sits in stunning lakeland scenery, with majestic views across Lake Windermere and the fells beyond.  Whether you are celebrating a special occasion, or simply looking to treat yourself, Afternoon Tea at Holbeck Ghyll Country House Hotel is the perfect way to indulge and relax in beautiful surroundings.  Served in the lake view restaurant, or terrace with panoramic views of Lake Windermere, the Afternoon Tea menu features a selection of handmade sweet and savoury treats, alongside your choice of tea or coffee. Add a glass of Champagne to add an extra touch of decadence.  Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available on request.  Afternoon Tea is served every day and costs £36 per person, or £48 with a glass of Champagne.
